items.q: A 54-year-old man with cirrhosis vomits massively despite two banding sessions and octreotide infusion. His airway is protected and blood flows freely. Which rescue indication best earns urgent TIPS in this band-refractory variceal bleeder?
o: Refractory variceal bleeding defeating bands and drugs
Heart failure with severe pulmonary hypertension
items.exp:
**Answer: A - Refractory variceal bleeding defeating bands and drugs.** Endoscopy-proof bleeding needs pressure dropped at its portal source, which shunts achieve directly.
**Why the others are wrong**
- B: Mild varices need surveillance only
- C: Heart failure forbids shunt flooding
- D: Sepsis forbids graft placement
**Key point:** Band-proof bleeding earns urgent TIPS.
items.kp: Band-refractory variceal bleeding earns urgent TIPS.

items.kp: Refractory ascites needing frequent taps suits TIPS.
